notes: EVERY REFUSAL IS NOW SPOKEN ALOUD, NOT MERELY DISPLAYED. When the app declines to post — the period is closed, the cheque number is already spent, the payment would overdraw the float — it shows a red notice. Screen-reading software could not see 106 of the 108 notices in the product. An operator working by ear heard nothing and carried on believing the posting had gone through, which is the most dangerous way for a refusal to fail. All of them now announce themselves, and an error interrupts where a confirmation politely waits. THE TABLES NOW DECLARE WHICH HEADING OWNS WHICH FIGURE. In 620 places a heading was visible on screen but never declared as one, so an amount could be read out with no indication of what it was the amount of. THE FIELDS IN THE GRIDS NOW CARRY NAMES. Journal debit and credit, invoice lines, fuel-coupon batches, approval tiers, stock-take counts — 27 fields announced themselves as "edit, blank". Each now names its own row: "Debit, line 2". THE KEYBOARD REACHES THE WORK. A "skip to main content" link means Tab no longer walks the whole sidebar before arriving at the screen you are on — on every screen change. The sidebar now states which screen you are on rather than only colouring it. And every dialog — the confirmations, the password change, the lock screen, the quick-search — takes the keyboard when it opens, keeps it inside while open, and returns it to the control you opened it from. TWO FIGURES THAT MISDESCRIBED THEMSELVES. In the Import Wizard, discarding a file left the green "rows read, review below" banner over an empty screen. On the Dashboard, the badge on "Needs attention" counted warnings only, while the list beneath it showed warnings AND information — five items under a 3. AND A NEW RELEASE CHECK opens every screen in the built application and fails if any of them errors, renders empty, or throws while drawing. A previous version shipped with whole screens blank while every source-level test stayed green, because the fault lay in the packaging and not the logic. That class of fault can no longer leave here unseen. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your books and settings are untouched and this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
